title: Federated Graph Neural Network for Anti-Money Laundering (AML)
summary: A federated learning and graph neural network system for detecting anti-money-laundering and trade-based money-laundering patterns across simulated bank data silos. Its utilities/gen.py script uses SDV's HMASynthesizer with MultiTableMetadata to generate the synthetic multi-table banking data (KYC, transfers, trade documents) that feeds the pipeline.
